exp.desc:
- Built log analysis
- Phishing incident response and evidence preservation
- Awareness sessions for 300 staff

cl.p1: when a phishing wave hit our company last autumn, I was the one who spotted the first suspicious login, locked the affected accounts and preserved the evidence. After that I decided to specialise in security.
cl.p2: Seven years of systems administration gave me the foundation: networks, directory services, firewalls, patching. In the last two years I also built our log analysis, ran phishing awareness sessions and earned an incident handling certification. A financial institution sets a high bar, which is exactly why I want to work for one.

cl.p1: three years of shifts in a security operations centre taught me to find the one alert that matters among thousands. I now want to go further and investigate incidents myself, not just escalate them.
cl.p2: I analyse logs, network traffic and endpoint data, write detection rules and have worked on two ransomware incidents for clients. In my spare time I compete in capture-the-flag events.
